decision.observed_event: Turn order: the fourth player, the dealer, the door-side player, the fresco-side player, you. The fourth player hits you once: 7 bludgeoning damage. The dealer hits you twice: 6 slashing and 5 piercing damage. The door-side player hits you: 4 slashing damage. The fresco-side player attacks and misses. Your greataxe hits the dealer. The dealer is hurt. The fourth player hits you twice: 21 bludgeoning damage. The dealer breaks off, snatches up what he can reach, and runs out through the south door, shouting blame at the others over his shoulder. The door-side player bolts through the south door after the dealer. The fresco-side player shoves past the table and runs out through the south door. Your turn.

improv_read.connection: The crew breaks and flees; one stays.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit keeps the round clear and ends on the strange calm of the one who stayed.

public_brief.objective: Hold the room alone against the barbarian.
public_brief.tactic: Stand fast while the others flee, and face her.
public_brief.visible_cue: The fourth player stays, unhurt, while the others run.
public_brief.player_opening: It is her turn to act.
public_brief.reply_to: Rolling initiative if it comes to that. I rage and swing my greataxe.
public_brief.kit_focus: Play the round in order, then leave the fourth player alone facing her.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, tight, no humor: crisp blow-by-blow, then her turn

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The fourth player's sap lands first, then the dealer twice and the door-side knife; one swing misses. Raging, Brakka hews into the dealer. The fourth player cracks her ribs twice more, and the rest break for the south door, ring and all.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: This is your doing, all of you! I said leave the gold! I said she wanted it! Run, you idiots, run, and the next time I tell you a thing, listen to me!

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: Forty-three damage. Only the fourth player stayed. Your turn.
